summary: The 3GPP identified cases in which SIP private header extensions, the P- header fields defined in RFC 7315, need to appear in requests and responses where RFC 7315 does not allow them. This informational document updates RFC 7315 to allow that. It was replaced by RFC 9878.

eli5.summary: Some special labels on phone-call messages were not allowed in certain messages, but the phone standards group needed them. This relaxes the rule. It has since been replaced by RFC 9878.
